how do i give you my documents?

Drop .md or .txt files into the data/docs folder (subfolders are fine). From then on, asking me things like "search my docs for the deploy plan" will find and quote the relevant part, with the file name.

whats the difference between your knowledge base and my docs

The knowledge base is a curated set of general facts (capitals, science basics) that ships with me and that you can extend. Your docs are your own files in data/docs, searched as-is. When you ask something factual I check the knowledge base first, then your documents.
